name: env-butler
title: Env Butler
description: Manage all your projects' .env files and global shell config, right from Raycast. Local-only, keyboard-first, free.
author: xiuman

commands.name: manage-envs
commands.title: Manage Envs
commands.subtitle: Env Butler
commands.description: Open a project's .env file and manage its variables, environments, and snapshots.

commands.name: search-env-vars
commands.title: Search Env Vars
commands.subtitle: Env Butler
commands.description: Quickly search environment variables across all registered projects.

preferences.name: language
preferences.title: Language / 界面语言
preferences.description: Env Butler 界面显示语言 / Display language for Env Butler's interface

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
